answers.answer: COOLING FINS Maintenance Interval The cylinder cooling fins should cleaned after every hours operation, or once a week, whichever comes first. Air must flow freely around and through the cylinder cooling fins to prevent engine overheating. Leaves, grass, dirt and debris buildup on the fins will increase the operating temperature the engine, which can reduce engine performance and shorten engine life.

To prevent overheating and engine seizure, cooling air comes from the intake grille the fan housing and is pushed the blower fan through an opening in the fan housing over the cylinder fin area, taking away combustion heat.
